# Claritev Selected by GDIT to Support CDC’s World Trade Center Health Program


Claritev will support General Dynamics Information Technology by providing the Nationwide Provider Network for World Trade Center Responders and Survivors


**MCLEAN, VA** — September 22, 2026 — Claritev Corporation (NYSE: CTEV), a healthcare technology, data, and insights company focused on making healthcare more affordable, transparent and fair for all, has been selected by General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) to support the World Trade Center (WTC) Health Program. The WTC Health Program is a limited federal health care program established under the James Zadroga 9/11 Health and Compensation Act of 2010 (Extended in 2015). It provides nationwide medical monitoring and treatment to responders and survivors of the events of September 11, 2001.


As part of GDIT’s team, Claritev will leverage its existing provider network to administer the Nationwide Provider Network (NPN), ensuring members across the country have access to available, high-quality healthcare. Claritev’s extensive network will connect Survivors and Responders who reside outside of the New York metropolitan area with healthcare providers experienced in diagnosing and treating unique conditions related to 9/11 exposures.


> *Claritev is honored to contribute to such a meaningful program that continues to service those affected by the events of September 11,”* said Travis Dalton, CEO and President of Claritev. *“Our extensive provider network and decades of healthcare data experience position us to ensure that every WTC Health Program member has access to the care they deserve, no matter where they now live.”*


Claritev’s role will focus on network development, credentialing, and maintaining provider access across the country for members who reside outside of the New York metropolitan area to receive care for their certified WTC-related health conditions.


## **About Claritev**


Claritev is a healthcare technology, data, and insights company focused on delivering affordability, transparency, and quality across the U.S. healthcare system. Led by deeply experienced associates, data scientists, and innovators, Claritev provides technology-enabled solutions fueled by decades of claims expertise. The company leverages advanced analytics and AI to power a robust enterprise platform that delivers clear, actionable insights to support affordability, price transparency, and optimized network and benefits design. By supporting key stakeholders — including payers, employers, patients, providers, and third parties — Claritev is dedicated to making healthcare more accessible and affordable for all.


Claritev serves more than 750 healthcare payers, over 100,000 employers, 60 million consumers, and 1.4 million contracted providers. For more information, visit[claritev.com](https://www.claritev.com/) .
